name: Checkout Bot Shield
author: Pluximo

sections.description:
Why it exists

Some bots hit online stores with many checkout attempts in a row. Often they are testing stolen credit card numbers to find ones that work. This brings fake orders, ties up your stock and revenue, and slows your site down for real customers.

What it does

Checkout Bot Shield counts how many times each visitor tries to check out. After 3 attempts within 5 minutes, the next attempt is blocked and the visitor sees “Too many checkout attempts. Please try again later.” The block lifts 5 minutes after their first attempt.

A real shopper who tries to check out more than 3 times in 5 minutes is blocked too.

It works on both the block checkout and the classic checkout page. There is nothing to set up: protection starts as soon as you activate the plugin. Every blocked attempt is recorded in your WooCommerce logs.

Who it is for

WooCommerce store owners who want protection against checkout bots that starts as soon as the plugin is active.

The Pro edition is trusted by 1,000+ stores; this Lite version is a hands-on demo so you can see how it behaves before upgrading.

Get help from an AI assistant

With the WordPress MCP Adapter set up, you can connect an AI assistant to help with blocked shoppers. The adapter lets an assistant use tools on your WordPress site.

The assistant can tell you whether a shopper is blocked and how many seconds remain before they can try again. It can also unblock one shopper or all shoppers at once. Unblock requests are recorded in your WooCommerce logs.

To find one shopper, use their IP address or the shopper ID labeled session_hash in a Checkout Bot Shield log entry. The connected account must have permission to manage WooCommerce or administer the site.

Prompts you can copy

Copy one of these prompts into your connected AI assistant. Replace [shopper IP address] with the shopper’s internet address, also called an IP address. Replace [shopper ID] with the full value labeled session_hash in a Checkout Bot Shield log entry.

Find out whether a shopper is blocked

  • “Is Checkout Bot Shield blocking the shopper with IP address [shopper IP address]?”
  • “Is Checkout Bot Shield blocking the shopper with shopper ID [shopper ID]?”

Find out how long a shopper must wait

  • “How long must the shopper with IP address [shopper IP address] wait before Checkout Bot Shield lets them try checkout again?”
  • “How long must the shopper with shopper ID [shopper ID] wait before Checkout Bot Shield lets them try checkout again?”

Unblock one shopper

  • “Use Checkout Bot Shield to unblock the shopper with IP address [shopper IP address].”
  • “Use Checkout Bot Shield to unblock the shopper with shopper ID [shopper ID].”
  • “If Checkout Bot Shield is blocking the shopper with IP address [shopper IP address], unblock them and tell me their block status afterward.”
  • “If Checkout Bot Shield is blocking the shopper with shopper ID [shopper ID], unblock them and tell me their block status afterward.”

Unblock everyone

  • “Use Checkout Bot Shield to unblock all shoppers now.”

Unblocking clears recent checkout attempts for the selected shopper or everyone. New checkout attempts still count toward the normal limit.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later.
  • WooCommerce installed and active.
  • PHP 8.2.35 or later. Your hosting provider can confirm this.

How to check it works

  1. Go to your shop and try to check out 4 times within 5 minutes.
  2. The first 3 attempts are not blocked. The 4th shows “Too many checkout attempts. Please try again later.” You can check out again after 5 minutes.
  3. In your dashboard, go to WooCommerce → Status → Logs and open the file starting with cbshield- to see the blocked attempt.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the plugin’s zip file.
  2. Click Activate. Protection starts right away.
  3. If your site runs behind a CDN or proxy service, read the next section.

Sites behind a CDN or proxy

The plugin tells visitors apart by their internet address (IP address). If your site runs behind a CDN or proxy, your server may see that service’s address instead of each shopper’s. Then all shoppers look like one visitor and can be blocked together.

You don’t need to change anything yourself. Send this message to your hosting provider:

“I’m using the Checkout Bot Shield plugin, which tells visitors apart by their IP address. Please confirm my site sees each visitor’s real IP address. If we use a CDN or proxy, please make sure it is set up securely so visitors can’t fake their address.”
sections.faq:
Will it slow down my checkout?

No. It only runs a quick check when someone places an order.

Can I change the limit?

Yes. A developer can change the number of allowed attempts with one line of code.

Where can I see blocked attempts?

In your dashboard, go to WooCommerce → Status → Logs and look for files starting with cbshield-.

Does it send data anywhere?

Checkout checks and logs stay on your site. If you connect an AI assistant through the WordPress MCP Adapter, the assistant receives the results of its requests.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0 – 27.10.2026

  • New: Protects the classic checkout page too.
  • New: A connected AI assistant can show whether a shopper is blocked and how long they must wait.
  • New: A connected AI assistant can unblock one shopper or all shoppers at once, with unblock requests recorded in WooCommerce logs.
  • Improved: Stronger protection against bots that try to get around the limit.
  • Improved: Real shoppers are less likely to be blocked by mistake.
  • Improved: Every blocked attempt now shows up in the logs.
  • Fix: An error that could appear during some bot attacks.

1.0.1 – 31.05.2026

  • Improved: Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.0 – 02.01.2026

  • Initial release: Limits repeated checkout attempts and records them in the WooCommerce logs.

short_description: Stops bots from flooding your WooCommerce checkout with fake orders.
